counterfactual_missing_items: No explicit confirmation of sarcoma over STUMP
No immunohistochemical or molecular data to distinguish the two
decisive_items: A provisional diagnosis of prostatic sarcoma was made
The biopsy result was interpreted as either prostatic stromal sarcoma or prostatic stromal tumor of uncertain malignant potential
response.rationale: Both candidates share identical raw support spans, so the distinction rests on clinical context. The vignette explicitly states a provisional diagnosis of prostatic sarcoma, and the aggressive features (large mass, bladder/rectal invasion) favor a malignant process over a tumor of uncertain malignant potential. Thus, R1 is the more likely diagnosis.

rejected.why: STUMP is a lower-grade entity; the clinical presentation with invasion and provisional sarcoma diagnosis makes it less likely than sarcoma.
